weak_reason: R-squared = 9.4% against the 10% weak-instrument threshold; the 90% confidence interval [0.27, 0.56] spans 0.70x the point estimate

adopted.basis: tier-1 own-stock weekly regression against its own local index (usability gate PASSED)
adopted.why: n = 215 weekly observations against the ADX general index, R-squared = 0.094 against the 0.05 floor, SE(beta) = 0.088 against |beta| = 0.415. All three conditions of the usability gate are met, so the regression estimate is adopted rather than a default.
adopted.corroboration: Cross-checked three ways. (i) The Dimson sum-beta is 0.351 with a 90% interval of [0.06, 0.64]; the adopted 0.42 sits inside it. (ii) The same regression against an equal-weight composite of the other 17 names in the AE library gives 0.271 (R-squared 0.088) — a different construction of 'the market' reaching a similar answer. (iii) The simple prior for a cyclical, capital-intensive materials business is 1.0-1.5 and for a defensive or staple business 0.6-0.9; the adopted figure is read against both in the study rather than accepted at face value.

dimson.note: Dimson (1979) sum-beta over one lead, the contemporaneous term and two lags. The uplift over the contemporaneous OLS beta measures how much co-movement is booked late because the stock does not trade on every session.

composite_corroboration.note: An equal-weight composite of the other AE names in the price library, the regressor the previous revision of this study used. It is retained as a corroboration only. An equal-weight composite over-weights small, thinly traded constituents, which is why the capitalisation-weighted general index is the correct regressor and this is the cross-check.

index_membership.note: The subject IS a constituent of its own regressor, which injects a self-covariance term into the numerator exactly as it did with the composite. The difference is magnitude: in a seventeen-name equal-weight composite the subject carried about a seventeenth of the index; in a free-float capitalisation-weighted general index with roughly a 10% float it carries well under one per cent. The contamination is therefore an order of magnitude smaller and is bounded above rather than assumed away.

thin_trading.note: Share of sessions closing unchanged, against the median of the AE library and against the index itself. A high ratio is the documented mechanism for a downward-biased contemporaneous beta, and it is why the Dimson correction is run.

plausibility.net_cash_note: The company carries roughly 0.8x net debt to EBITDA and its earnings are levered to a global commodity price benchmark, both of which argue for an estimate at or above the cyclical band rather than below it.
